scope: Analysis of existing 500 Hz closed-loop history; controller/source unchanged, no new physics run.
reference: COM velocity and acceleration errors use the active control reference, not a newly reconstructed raw-PKL COM reference. Root position error uses the existing original-PKL audit.
sign: Errors are actual minus reference; xyz are world coordinates. Signed integrals are bookkeeping, not independent causal interventions.
observed_acceleration: Forward difference of model-derived COM velocity over the completed 2 ms interval, not a direct physical accelerometer.
